policies.title: Inferred Controller Software Candidate Promotion
policies.reuse_scope: Cross-document: controller/ECU actor + literal executable behavior + no high-confidence non-SW allocation
policies.notes: 명시적 SW allocation 문구가 없어도 Controller/ECU/HU의 Source-backed executable behavior는 review-required candidate로 보존한다. 개별 SRS의 공식 SW allocation 승인과는 구분한다.

policies.title: Candidate Verification Generation Before Allocation Sign-off
policies.reuse_scope: Cross-document: inferred SW candidate only; no synthetic test data; result fields blank
policies.notes: 사람의 최종 allocation 승인 전에도 Source-backed Candidate TC/Intent Draft를 생성할 수 있으나 REVIEW_REQUIRED/HOLD를 유지한다.

policies.title: Mixed-domain Parent Requirement Handling
policies.reuse_scope: Cross-document: one Canonical parent with fact-level verification domains >=2
policies.notes: Canonical Parent는 유지하고 fact-level scope를 분리한다. 다른 domain fact는 삭제하지 않고 Review/Allocation context에 보존한다.

policies.title: OPEN Semantic Unit Disposition
policies.reuse_scope: Cross-document: open Semantic Unit after duplicate/context/external-reference review
policies.notes: OPEN Semantic Unit은 자동 종결하지 않는다. 사람의 검토와 근거 기록 하에 Existing Canonical/SRS 직접 연결, 신규/확장 SRS, Gap/Conflict, External Dependency, 또는 완전한 중복/비규범적 배경 문장에 한한 Intentional Exclusion으로만 terminal disposition한다. 고유 normative behavior, 조건 논리, timing, 수치, 금지사항, 오류 대응, 상태 전이 또는 외부 규격 준수 의무가 있으면 Intentional Exclusion으로 종결하지 않는다.

policies.title: Shared Literal Fact with Parent-context Allocation
policies.reuse_scope: Cross-document: identical literal fact shared by multiple parents with divergent allocation/domain
policies.notes: 물리 Source Fragment는 하나로 보존하고 parent별 contextual alias와 allocation rationale을 명시한다.

policies.title: Review/Hold Requirement Preservation
policies.reuse_scope: All documents and all engineering requirement views
policies.notes: REVIEW_REQUIRED/HOLD 항목은 삭제하지 않고 Main Requirement Specification 및 Review View에 보존한다. Official Release에서 제외할 수는 있으나 Source→Canonical→Review/Decision traceability는 유지한다.

policies.title: Engineering E2E Requirement Preservation
policies.reuse_scope: All documents: Canonical Engineering Requirement before SYS/SWE domain projection
policies.notes: Not SWE.1 != Not Requirement. Source-backed normative engineering facts are preserved as Canonical Engineering Requirements and then projected to SYS.1/SWE.1/native domain views. REVIEW_REQUIRED/HOLD remains visible.
policies.source: User-approved V0.80 SYS/SWE E2E expansion directive

policies.title: System Verification Candidate Preservation
policies.reuse_scope: System-level requirements and system facts not eligible for SWE.6
policies.notes: Not SWE.6 != Not Verifiable. System-level Source-backed facts remain available as SYS.5 System Qualification Candidate intents; no Source-missing test values or results are invented.
policies.source: User-approved V0.80 SYS/SWE E2E expansion directive
